newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks seen soft in thin volume, peso flat.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks seen soft in thin volume, peso flat.

text.p: --Mexico stocks seen off at open in thin volume
--Peso likely sideways on lack U.S. brokers
Traders saw stocks opening with mild downside potential at very slow dealing due to the absence of U.S. investors commemorating Memorial Day.
"It will be a lazy day. We may slide 10 points, but that will be it. There won't be any sharp movements," one desk trader said.
Technical analysts situated support at 3,970 points, compared to Friday's close of 3,988.29 points.
Traders expected a quiet session for the peso, again due to Memorial Day. Furthermore, most banks had already squared their books and corporate demand for greenbacks was seen unlikely, dealers said.
Dealers forecast a trading range of 7.8700/7.8800 per dollar for the 48-hour peso. Pre-open bids stood at 7.8750/7.8800 per dollar, compared to Friday's close of 7.8780/7.8810.
Overnight rates on Cetes were seen opening near Friday's close of 17.55 percent in dull volume and trading.
